findings.issue: Same-day weather (temp, atemp, hum, windspeed, weather_severity) is used as a feature. It is measured on the day being predicted, so it is only legitimate if a weather forecast is available at prediction time.
findings.why_it_matters: This is not target leakage (check_identity returned clean on all 15 features). It is an assumption about what is known at prediction time, and the README should state it.

findings.issue: The working tree has an uncommitted edit that removes the local Ollama model and env config from settings.json.
findings.why_it_matters: This does not affect the pipeline or the metrics, but the repo state differs from the committed one.
